common_rules: RULES: Your working directory is {RUNDIR}. You have MCP tools from the server "765t-forge" (an AutoCAD bridge). Use ONLY those MCP tools to open, read, modify, and save drawings. Do NOT write or run any scripts (python, lisp, .scr, .dxf editing, command-line utilities) that manipulate drawing files or AutoCAD directly. Do NOT use shell commands except plain file listing. If a capability you need is missing from the tools, report it instead of working around it. Never fake a CAD object with lines+text when a real object type exists. When finished, save, then reply with DONE plus a one-line list of what you created.

tasks.title: Dimension a floor plan
tasks.prompt: Open the drawing {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (units mm, building plan drawn 1:1). Add proper dimensioning: (a) overall dimensions on BOTH plan axes — the full 12000 mm width and the 5400 mm overall height, (b) a continuous dimension chain along the bottom edge of the left wing segmenting it at its internal partition (segments must sit on one shared dimension line and sum to the wing's extent), and (c) a dimension for the door opening in that partition. Put all dimensions on a dedicated annotation layer named A-DIMS as REAL dimension objects with ONE consistent dimension style appropriate for 1:100 output (plotted text height 2.5 mm). No dimension line may cross a wall interior and no label may overlap another object. Do not draw fake dimensions out of lines and text. Save the result as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: Annotate rooms with name + area
tasks.prompt: Open {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (mm). It has three closed room boundaries on layer A-ROOM. Also read {RUNDIR}\rooms.json which names them LIVING, KITCHEN, BED matching the polygons in file order. Annotate each room with one MTEXT label on layer A-ANNO placed inside its boundary: first line the room name, second line the computed area in square metres like '22.68 m2' (area from the actual boundary geometry). Use an area field if the tools offer one. Save the result as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: Layout + attributed title block + 1:50 viewport
tasks.prompt: Open {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (mm). The drawing defines a block TBLK with attributes SHEET_NO, SHEET_NAME, SCALE, DATE. Read {RUNDIR}\register.json — it gives the four attribute values for this sheet. Create a new paper-space layout named 'A1-SHEET', insert TBLK on it, fill its four attributes from the register, and add a viewport that shows model space at exactly 1:50. Save the result as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: Duct run with masked MLEADER size tags
tasks.prompt: Open {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (mm). It is a corridor 18000 x 2400 with crossing lines at x=4500, 9000, 13500. Draw the main duct as ONE polyline on layer M-DUCT running the full corridor length along its centreline (y=1200). Add at least two multileader (MLEADER) size tags 'D 630x400' on layer M-ANNO, each with a background mask on the text, pointing at the duct, placed where the tag text is NOT crossed by any line. Save the result as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: Normalize messy drawing to a layer standard
tasks.prompt: Open {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (mm). Normalize every entity to this layer standard: wall geometry to A-WALL, door swing geometry to A-DOOR, dimension-like geometry to A-DIMS, annotation text to A-TEXT. Create layers if missing. Move ALL entities to their correct standard layer, leave zero entities on the old names (wall, WALL-NEW, walls, Dim-2, TEXT-XX, misc, 0), then remove the empty old layers if the tools allow. Save the result as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: Rebuild exploded dimensions as real DIMENSIONs
tasks.prompt: Open {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (mm). Along the bottom there are exploded pseudo-dimensions: extension lines, dimension lines, tick marks and text labels that only LOOK like dimensions. Replace them with REAL dimension objects measuring the actual wall geometry: a continuous chain 3600 / 2400 / 3600 and an overall 9600 dimension, all on layer A-DIMS. Delete the fake pieces. Save the result as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: Publish a 3-sheet PDF with bookmarks
tasks.prompt: Open {RUNDIR}\seed.dxf (mm). It has three layouts: P1-PLAN, P2-DET, P3-ELEV. Make sure all three layouts have a working DWG-to-PDF page setup, then publish all three to ONE multi-sheet PDF at {RUNDIR}\set.pdf with a bookmark per sheet. Save the drawing as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg.

tasks.title: DGN to DWG conversion + QA
tasks.prompt: Convert the MicroStation DGN file {RUNDIR}\seed.dgn into an AutoCAD DWG saved as {RUNDIR}\answer.dwg. After converting, run whatever drawing QA / pre-check the tools offer and report the result. Use only the MCP tools; do not call external converters.
